description: List the chemicals in your own SDSentry inventory: product, manufacturer, location, storage spot, whether an SDS is on file, the revision date recorded for the sheet, and a link to each sheet. Optional "location" narrows the list to locations whose name contains that text. Needs a personal SDSentry access token (created by the account owner in SDSentry, Admin, AI assistants) and an account on a free trial or a paid plan. Read-only; reads only that account's data.

location.description: Optional: part of a location name in your account, e.g. "Main clinic".

name: list_my_chemicals
title: List the chemicals in my SDSentry inventory
